Workers hold no catalog or database credential: commands and their link callbacks travel on Redis db 8 (its own
visibility timeout), results as files on the library export. Until gateway exports digitized read-write over NFS,
the only fallback is hostPath on gateway, which competes with production for its 8 cores.
